Instrument audio attribution — コードの聴き取り単語帳

FluidR3 GM SoundFont by Frank Wen and contributors.
Copyright (c) 2000-2002, 2008 Frank Wen.
MP3 rendering and distribution: gleitz / MIDI.js Soundfonts.
Source: https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/tree/gh-pages/FluidR3_GM
Source README: https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/blob/gh-pages/README.md
Distributor's stated license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 US
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/

Included instruments:
- acoustic_grand_piano-mp3.js
- acoustic_guitar_steel-mp3.js
- electric_guitar_clean-mp3.js

Changes: embedded MP3 data extracted as separate, unmodified MP3 files;
piano notes C3 through Bb6 (MIDI 48–94), and guitar notes E2 through Bb6 (MIDI 40–94) selected. Gain and note duration are
adjusted at playback, with short amplitude fades. No endorsement implied.

The original FluidR3 is additionally released under the MIT license:
https://sources.debian.org/src/fluid-soundfont/3.1-5.2/README
